title: Electric field ratio
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be the correct ratio E'/E = 6/5 or 1.2.

title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be the correct magnitude a = 2 m/s².

title: Uniform motion time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be the correct time t1 = 0.3 s.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Newton's second law, relating the electric force and gravitational force before and after the plate is moved.

title: Kinematics for accelerated segment
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the time (t2) for the vertical motion after the plate is lifted, using the correct vertical displacement (d/2) and acceleration.

title: Electric field relationship
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the electric field to the plate separation and constant voltage (E = U/d) to find the ratio E'/E.

title: Total time calculation
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly calculate the total time to cross the capacitor (t = L/v0 = 0.5 s) as an intermediate step.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Deduct if the calculated acceleration has the wrong sign or if the direction of the net force is misinterpreted after the plate is lifted.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Deduct if units (cm, m, s) are mixed incorrectly in calculations without consistent conversion.
